# Installation

Follow the steps below to install the example CLI on your machine.

:::note
Node.js 18 or later is required before you continue.
:::

<Tabs>
<TabItem label="npm">

```bash
npm install -g example-cli
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem label="pnpm">

```bash
pnpm add -g example-cli
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Verifying the install

Run `example-cli --version` and confirm it prints a version number.
